name: DetectConditionalAccessDrift
label: Detect Conditional Access Drift
helpText: Flags every Conditional Access policy in the tenant that is not covered by a CA template from a baseline applying to it (matched by display name across ALL baselines). Each unmanaged policy is its own deviation: accept it to tolerate a tenant-specific policy, or deny it to queue it for deletion. Report-only - nothing is ever changed automatically.
executiveText: Watches for sign-in security policies created outside the agreed baseline - for example by a local admin - and raises each one for review, so unauthorized changes to account protection never go unnoticed.
